_doc: S81-CORES kits_repin (10-24): ORFS kits for the re-pinned / re-floorplanned closed sub-leaf cores. Sources, params and macros are read from the ref_tile spec.json at generation time (the closed kit's own file list); only the outline and pins change (plan pin tables in inputs/core_pins). util = the closed kit's PLACE_DENSITY (spec route.pd / util). cts_args = the closed kit's CTS setting where it had one.

ot_s81sl_vs.face_guard_continue: r2 face_guard FAIL (RTL property: 128 unused ve_oy / 2 s_d input bits have no capture flop; x_wd/u/sw_d/ve_ah/ve_rh/x_wa/... output registers also read internally; ve_aval merged with sw_d): physical run continues as pathfinding for pins / route / timing evidence

ot_s81sl_vq.macro_site_note: r2 (site [55.296, 4.32], rows halo 2): GRT-0183 boxed-in net next to the SRAM W pin wall; review 10-24: the new E face carries u/um (vs) over the full height, so the E channel beside the SRAM (22.7 um) took ~90 u face flops + their 256-b stream detour. r3: SRAM centred on the S face (x 38.988 = 722 sites, y 4.32 = core edge, M4 pins on 0.012 + k 0.048), 34.2 um channels to both W (y, vn) and E (u, vs) faces, rows halo 4.32. The S face has no pins; N (xf leaf bus) 80 um above the SRAM.

rtl_patch.why: COORD ruling 10-24 (no waiver for the self-loop fault flop): kit-local duplicate sticky flop. fault_q (internal, keep) carries the sticky state; the port flop fault takes the SAME next state (fault_q | events) from fault_q, so its Q drives only the port (face_guard). Same reset, same edge: fault == fault_q every cycle; 0 added cycles; ports unchanged.
mutant:
fault <= fault_q | (vo && af) | ord_f | mcol | (mv_c && umv_c) | (yv_c && uv_c) | (vo && blo && run);
            fault <= fault_q | (vo && af) | ord_f | mcol | (mv_c && umv_c) | (vo && blo && run);

rtl_patch.why: COORD ruling 10-24 (no waiver for the self-loop fault flop): kit-local duplicate sticky flop. fault_q (internal, keep) holds the sticky state; the port flop fault <= fault_q | chk (= its own next state), so its Q drives only the port. 0 added cycles; ports unchanged.
mutant:
else fault <= fault_q | chk;
else fault <= fault_q;
